issues: Sales missed target by £2.51 after a book tour event closed half the restaurant for a day, and wages were higher from pre event cleaning and event hours (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 24/11).
Seasonal matcha specials drove strong drinks sales, while sushi sales dropped.
A 1 star Google review about a seating dispute over reserved tables was addressed; the week's reviews were seven 5 star, one 4 star and one 1 star (M8 GM/HC meeting 23/11).
Card machine 3 is being replaced, and a sticker on the glass entrance is proving hard to remove.
The kitchen took 16 minutes to make the ramen at the book launch, the longest of all the launches, which Scott linked to FOH training gaps such as wrong orders and unclear ticket modifications.
An early morning inspection found FIFO not followed, boxes left open overnight and prep left out in the fry section, and a formal corrective report went to the BOH team.
Desserts now go on separate tickets, out of stock items go on whiteboard sticky notes as well as to the manager, and free staff matcha has stopped because of the cost (£150 per box).
Factory staff are covering holidays, with concerns about their readiness for Christmas bookings, and Maki 6 may need extra help.
FOH is not ringing up every drink on the till, including custom drink ingredients, and the extra sauce charge button is still waiting to be added.
Hygiene checks, the waste log, sickness and lateness records and rotas were all complete.
New chashu products are already in use at M8, and diluted chicken broth samples tested at M8 had positive feedback on salt levels (Admin Meeting 23/11).
Ross completed the M8 grease trap work (Ross Ward weekly report w/c 16/11).
